# Results (synthetic)

Scores differed between groups (t(48) = 2.10, P = .041). The interaction was significant,
F(2, 57) = 3.40, p = 0.04. Uptake differed across the three sites, χ2(2, N = 120) = 7.40, P = .025.
Ranks differed (z = 2.31, P = 0.021). The trend did not reach significance, t(25) = 1.80, P = 0·08.
The largest difference was z = 4.50, P = 6.8 × 10−6. A borderline result, t(20) = 2.09, P = .049.
The rounded statistic t(40) = 2.0, P = .047 is also consistent. A standardized score of
z = 1.2 was recorded for reference.
